title: I need help with mt5 EA
author: Dull_Barber_7783
selftext:
For context I was scrolling on social media and this trading bot come across my feed on a livestream, at first I thought it was a scam until I joined the telegram group and got to talking to the “owner” everything seemed legitimate and he sent me over everything I asked for. I caved in and thought, I might as well. so I took a shot in the dark and bought it.

as I suspected it is not working how it’s supposed to (what they have been showing in their lives and telegram), I don’t know if that is due to my spreads but I am using vantage the same broker as they were 

So if anyone here knows anything about coding EA’s please reply to this any feedback and/or help will be appreciated 

I’ll put the code in the comments ⬇️

comments.author: Dull_Barber_7783

replies.author: BlackOpz
replies.body: Looks like AI code (if it works, it works). Realistic bots will have far larger profit targets since LIVE trading has delays and slippage that would kill this bot. I'll test and update this post after I test it. (my hand-coded bot is about 2000 lines)

comments.author: CommandantZ
comments.body:
Professional EA developer here,

Forget it, it won't work. I had a quick look, this is a classic tick scalper made to function in demo / backtests but will absolutely not work in real conditions. (Due to how close to freeze levels the SL is moved and so on). 

The EA is also extremely simplistic, no specific logic at all.

Generally speaking, anyone offering you the source code for very cheap is probably dishonest. No developer in their right mind would sell the source code unless for a great amount of money.

replies.author: Dull_Barber_7783
replies.body: What should I do to actually make or find an ea that works?

replies.author: CommandantZ
replies.body: I made a cool introductory post about EAs a few days ago, check out my profile, it'll already give you a bunch of infos. Then if you need more, feel free to ask.

replies.author: Dull_Barber_7783
replies.body: I’ve sent you a private message

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: sorry, that's a rough one. if it doesn't behave on the same broker they use, it's not your spreads. live results in a telegram stream are almost always a demo account or a hand picked one. I'd ask for a refund and not put any more money through it.
